svg.title: A pocket-sized snow village — step 4: Add doors and village paths
svg.desc: Press a shallow door shape into the front of each cottage without hollowing it out. Arrange a few stones at ground level around the doorway. Connect the houses with a finger-drawn path and use small stones or short twigs to mark its edges.
